author: coder
message:
docs(core): retire WC-17 and the issue pipeline duties from the worker contract (#655)

Remove rule WC-17 and the "Issue pipeline duties" section. Keep the one
sentence launch-level guard rule 2 relies on (ask and send carry no --to) as
its own bullet in the worker-session duties, and assert it in the contract
test. Fixes the missing contract text for the worker side of guard rule 2
(finding F14 of issue 665).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>

author: coder
message:
refactor(hooks): remove guard rule G2.1, the issue-pipeline TAMPER class (#655)

Remove the first G2 rule of launch-level-guard.sh (source and plugin copy,
byte-identical): the case that classed release-worker and the issue-pipeline
verbs as TAMPER. The verbs no longer exist. G2 rule 2 (a bound worker may run
orchestration send and ask only as one plain call with no --to) and the
guard's own sessions/<sid>.ok approval path are untouched.

Rewrite the module of the rule 2 tests so it no longer imports the deleted
package: the release is now a typed /sc:implement prompt, and the nonce
binding test builds its prompt from the _marker helper.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>

  yaml-deviation-class.yaml fixture: no hit for the dropped names, unchanged.
Also remove the issue-pipeline rows from docs/user-guide/cli-groups.md, which
documented a group that no longer exists (not in the PR D file list).
